name: TMGMT Export / Import JSON
description: TMGMT file translator that exports source data to JSON and imports the translated JSON back.
project_description:
A translator which allows you to export source data into a JSON and import the translated in return.

 It export/import the JSON in the following format:

 

{

 "job_id": "1",

 "source": "en",

 "target": "ru",

 "translations": [

 {

 "key": "1][title][0][value",

 "parent label": "Title",

 "label": "",

 "original": "This is a test page",

 "translated": "Это тестовая страница"

 },

 {

 "key": "1][body][0][value",

 "parent label": "Body",

 "label": "Text",

 "original": "Lorem Ipsum is simply dummy text.",

 "translated": "Lorem Ipsum - это текст-'рыба'."

 }

 ]

}

 

 Dependencies: 

 
 Translation Management Tool 
 
 Currently supported file formats: 

 
 JSON
